theme.color.title: Color theme
theme.color.description: The predefined GPUI Kit themes. Each one is light or dark.
theme.footer: Applies to this app on this computer only.
theme.mode.label: {name} ({mode})
text.size.title: Interface size
text.size.description: Scales text, spacing and controls together.
language.title: Language
language.description: The language of every label, message and button.
engine.name: Engine
engine.restart_footer: The engine keeps running behind its tray icon after this window closes; quit it from the icon. Restart stops the engine and starts a new one. Connections it holds, such as open WebSockets and captured traffic, are lost.
proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.footer: A new port takes effect at once while the proxy is running.
forward_proxy.title: Forward proxy
reverse_proxy.title: Reverse proxy
reverse_proxy.footer: A new port takes effect at once while the reverse proxy is running.
port.title: Port
port.forward_description: Point a browser or a tool at this port to route its traffic through the proxy rules, mocks and capture.
port.reverse_description: Where .localhost names are served and sent on to their mappings, over HTTPS while Intercept HTTPS is on. 80 (HTTP) or 443 (HTTPS) lets the names work without a port.
companion.title: Companion
companion.footer: The companion server always runs. A new port takes effect after the engine restarts.
https.intercept.title: Intercept HTTPS
https.intercept.description: Run Bifurc over HTTPS with its certificate: the reverse proxy serves .localhost names over HTTPS on its port, the forward proxy also accepts HTTPS proxy clients on its port, and HTTPS traffic through it is decrypted so rules, mocks and capture apply.
certificate.import_tooltip: Use your own certificate and private key instead
certificate.install_tooltip: Add the certificate to this computer's trusted roots
certificate.footer: The engine signs the sites it intercepts with this certificate, so install it to avoid warnings. Firefox keeps its own store and needs the certificate imported there.
account.none_footer: An account is only needed to sync a workspace with GitHub. Sign in when you add a workspace, or when you publish one from its Config.
account.footer: Signing out removes the account and its workspaces from this computer.
sign_out.title: Sign out @{login}?
sign_out.none: Bifurc forgets this account on this computer. No workspace uses it.
sign_out.removed_kept: Its workspaces are removed from this computer: {names}. They stay on GitHub and can be imported again.
sign_out.removed_lost: Its workspaces are removed from this computer: {names}. What was never synced is lost with them: {lost}.
telemetry.title: Anonymous usage analytics
telemetry.description: On by default. What kind of thing you do in the app and in your own workspaces, and where in Bifurc's own code it crashed or failed, never its content. Off, only that Bifurc was installed on this device is reported, once.
review.title: Rate Bifurc
review.link: Review Bifurc on the Microsoft Store
review.description: Tell others what you think. It takes a minute and helps more than you'd expect.
updates.automatic_description: Once a day. The request carries this app's version and nothing else.
update.unsupported: This version is no longer supported.
